searchText: Update on the Coorparoo devnet - found a bug in Teku's transition logic which is what caused the state root mismatch. Getting a fix in soon and will try and spin up another devnet. Fortunately Australia has plenty of weird place names to use. 🙂 I think I learned more about geography from testnet codenames than I learned at school. hahaha yeah dude
